_doc: The SA-02m-web-build quality-tools registry (PROTOCOL.md `## Quality tools`). The one home for 'what does GREEN mean for this web project'. Each row is a self-contained check the runner (`.ai-dev/quality/run.mjs <beat>`) executes wholesale for its beat. The Builder runs every `build`-beat tool on completion and hands back only when they pass; the Reviewer confirms the `review`-beat tools ran and reads their output; `ship`-beat tools run before the merge stamp. Adding or changing a tool = a row here + (optionally) its native config beside this file — never a runner edit.

_row_shape.checks: one plain line: what this tool catches
_row_shape.config: path to its native config beside this file, or null if none
_row_shape.run: the command to run it (from the project root — the runner's cwd)
_row_shape.covers: optional array of path prefixes/globs; run.mjs --touched runs a row only when the diff touches a covered path (rows without covers always run)
_row_shape.init: one line: how to install/enable it

tools.checks: Syntax errors in every hand-written frontend script — the top-level bundles (app.js, i18n.js, flasher.js, mqtt.js, gateway.js) and the app/*.js modules app.js was decomposed into (F10) — a broken script bricks the whole UI since there is no build step.
tools.run: bash -c 'set -e; for f in www/network_config/static/js/*.js www/network_config/static/js/app/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done'

tools.checks: Bash syntax errors in every CGI endpoint and shared lib — a broken CGI returns 500 with no client-side trace.
tools.run: bash -c 'set -e; for f in www/network_config/cgi-bin/*.cgi www/network_config/cgi-bin/lib_*.sh; do bash -n "$f"; done'

tools.checks: Syntax errors in every on-device Python service under opt/ (the Modbus-MQTT bridge, snapshot/scan/monitor helpers, the flasher) — a broken script fails only at systemd start on the device, with no build step to catch it.
tools.run: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys"; then exec "$p" -m compileall -q opt/; fi; done; echo py-syntax: no working python interpreter; exit 1'
tools.init: Python 3.10+ as python3, python, or py — same interpreter picker as version-consistency (Windows ships a non-functional python3 Store stub)

tools.checks: Bridge unit tests (opt/sa02m-modbus-mqtt/tests — FMB event manager generalization, MR-02m dispatch golden values, DTV event ranges/scaling) — a regression in the event path passes py-syntax but fails here.
tools.run: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys"; then exec "$p" -m unittest discover -s opt/sa02m-modbus-mqtt/tests -q; fi; done; echo py-unit: no working python interpreter; exit 1'
tools.init: Python 3.10+ (stdlib unittest, no extra deps) — same interpreter picker as py-syntax

tools.checks: Cloud-agent stdlib unit tests (opt/sa02m-cloud-agent/tests, unittest-style test_render*.py). Despite the pattern name this row now covers the whole agent seam: frpc.toml rendering + the device-side local-port allow-list (drops :22/:1883, keeps :80/:9999) + pinned transport TLS (A5 defense-in-depth), per-device identity metadatas emission and 0600 credential storage, the heartbeat send-only guarantee (threat-model F1), and revocation stand-down/recovery. The test_render*.py pattern deliberately excludes the pytest-style test_agent.py (pytest is not a device/CI dep) — widening it to test_*.py would fail the gate on the missing import.
tools.run: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys"; then exec "$p" -m unittest discover -s opt/sa02m-cloud-agent/tests -p "test_render*.py" -q; fi; done; echo py-unit-cloud: no working python interpreter; exit 1'
tools.init: Python 3.10+ (stdlib unittest, no extra deps) — same interpreter picker as py-unit

tools.checks: Flasher unit tests (opt/sa02m-flasher/tests, stdlib unittest) — firmware formats/repo, scan persist, MPLC port lease, application-line profiles, and the by-address bootloader reg-290 signature preflight (1.0.5.17). A regression in the flash routing/signature path passes py-syntax but fails here. Uses -t opt/sa02m-flasher so the sa02m_flasher package imports from any cwd.
tools.run: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys"; then exec "$p" -m unittest discover -s opt/sa02m-flasher/tests -t opt/sa02m-flasher -q; fi; done; echo py-unit-flasher: no working python interpreter; exit 1'
tools.init: Python 3.10+ (stdlib unittest, no extra deps) — same interpreter picker as py-unit

tools.checks: www/network_config/VERSION, APP_VERSION in app.js, and every ?v= cache-bust string agree with the version-named git branch — a skew ships stale cached assets to devices.
tools.run: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys"; then exec "$p" scripts/sync-app-version.py --check; fi; done; echo version-consistency: no working python interpreter; exit 1'
tools.init: Python 3.10+ as python3, python, or py — the runner picks the first that actually executes (Windows ships a non-functional python3 Store stub; Linux/CI resolves python3 first)

tools.checks: Frontend logic unit tests the js-syntax `node --check` cannot reach. Currently: clearSessionCookie() in app.js clears session_token at EVERY path prefix (the 401 auto-logout must evict the cloud-scoped Path=/devcfg/<id> cookie, not only Path=/). Stdlib-only Node (no framework), so no extra dep — mirrors the ui-layout row's dep-free/graceful posture.
tools.init: Node 18+ (stdlib only). Run on demand: node scripts/dev/test-clear-session-cookie.mjs

tools.checks: Bash syntax of the on-device installer.

Real bugs (severity=error) in every Bash CGI, shared lib, device script, and the installer — quoting/word-splitting/unset-var defects are the stated top defect class for this stack (web-code-rigor.md). Style/info/warning are intentionally NOT gated (severity=error only) so the row stays a bug gate, not a lint nag.
tools.init: shellcheck (preinstalled on GitHub ubuntu runners; `apt install shellcheck` / `brew install shellcheck` locally). Absent -> the row skips (exit 0), so Windows/dev boxes without it stay green; the Linux CI is the enforcing run.

tools.checks: Frontend regression smoke via the committed characterization harness (scripts/dev/characterize-ui.mjs --compare baseline): loads the dashboard headless over every tab/theme/variant and diffs globals + new console errors + DOM skeleton against the saved baseline (scripts/dev/baseline/). Catches a JS bundle break or a widget-id/skeleton regression no syntax check sees.
tools.init: cd scripts/dev && npm install && npx playwright install chromium; set SA02M_WEB_PASS and serve/point the harness (scripts/dev/README.md). Absent deps/password -> the row skips (exit 0); it is the on-demand real-layer UI check, not a headless-less CI gate.

tools.checks: Geometry/layout regressions the syntax and characterization rows can't see: renders the dashboard + Управление services-control block across 4 viewports x 2 themes x 2 HW variants and ASSERTS real getBoundingClientRect geometry (never CSS strings) — services column alignment (the 1.0.5.19 grid: manage/toggle/badge each one x-left per row), no horizontal overflow at the supported widths, touch-target sizes vs a printed deviation ledger, no dashboard card overlap. Also writes full-page screenshots per cell to the gitignored .ai-dev/quality/screenshots/ (просмотр вёрстки). Dev-only; never shipped to the device.
tools.init: npm run ui-layout:install (installs the scripts/dev playwright harness + chromium, reused by the driver). Absent chromium/playwright -> the row skips (exit 0), so CI (no browser) stays green; it is an on-demand real-layer layout check, not a headless-less CI gate. Run on demand: npm run ui-layout.
